verdict.rationale: Runpod's Serverless product directly matches the story: flex workers scale to zero when idle, billing is pay-per-second only while a worker runs, and code can be deployed via SDKs (Python/JS/Go), CLI, or Flash without managing always-on instances. Docs also address cold-start mitigation (FlashBoot/model caching), reinforcing the autoscale-to-zero model. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks of scale-to-zero latency/reliability and any community corroboration specifically about serverless (community evidence found only covers Pods, not Serverless).
